# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before proposing or editing code, read the repository root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow its mandatory bootstrap. Use [docs/17-AGENT-OPERATING-MODEL.md](../docs/17-AGENT-OPERATING-MODEL.md), [docs/18-EXECUTION-GRAPH.md](../docs/18-EXECUTION-GRAPH.md), and [docs/19-TRACEABILITY-MATRIX.md](../docs/19-TRACEABILITY-MATRIX.md) to navigate the product.

Do not assume documentation checkboxes prove implementation. Inspect source and tests. Work on `environment/local` unless the user explicitly instructs otherwise. Synchronize code, tests, task state, memory, roadmap and audit records. The product owner alone grants final acceptance.
